notes.title: Update #3: Chapter 2 Added
notes.content:
As we have said before, the early access for Weaverse is continuing to be improved. However, Yellow Cat-Rabbit is doing more than just fixing the bugs as they are presented. This next update includes an expansion to the game that many have been waiting for. The update that has just gone live includes the entirety of Chapter 2, side missions included!

Check out the full blog on the Odd Branch [url=https://www.oddbranch.com/weaverse-early-access-gets-an-expansion-update/]website[/url]!

notes.title: Update #2: New Weapon, Patches, and more
notes.content:
We continue to bring new updates to Weaverse and improve the overall experience during the Early Access just as we promised in our Road Map. We are proud to announce yet another update to the game which includes:
[list]
[*] Bugs fixed
[*] UI improved
[*] New game mechanic introduced (Ice Gun)
[*] Aguruh Map Rebuild and Expantion
[/list]

Be sure to see what changes we have provided in these cases and remember that you can report any bugs or problems to our email: Help@OddBranch.com

[url=https://www.oddbranch.com/weaverse-gets-a-second-early-access-update/]Full Announcement Here[/url]

notes.title: Update #1: Achievements, New Game Mode and More
notes.content:
[h1]Thanks to everyone who sent us feedback on how we can improve the game. Based on your feedback, the first update has been released and includes the following changes to the game:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] A whole new game mode for you to enjoy
[*] Lots of bugs fixed
[*] Improvements to the UI (teleport room in particular)
[/list]

[h1]The next major update is expected to be released on 14 June 2019. Make sure to send your suggestions and feedback to help@oddbranch.com.[/h1]

You can read the full announcement on this update on the latest Odd Branch [url=https://www.oddbranch.com/weaverse-first-early-access-update-is-live/]Devlog here[/url].
